stories.title: Ethan Pritchard was shot in the head, then 'a miracle' happened
stories.summary: The Florida State linebacker spent a month in a coma. It wasn't clear he'd ever wake up. Now, he's looking to play football again.

stories.title: LSU's Umanmielen served court papers from Ole Miss suit ahead of showdown
stories.summary: The LSU-Ole Miss rivalry took another dramatic turn Tuesday when Tigers star defensive end Princewill Umanmielen was served with court papers related to the Rebels' lawsuit against him, according to court records.

stories.title: Colts WR Allen charged with OWI, allegedly blew .224 on test
stories.summary: Colts wide receiver Keenan Allen was formally charged with two misdemeanor drunken driving charges on Wednesday.

stories.title: Browns QB Watson: Focus on winning, not job security
stories.summary: Browns quarterback Deshaun Watson said Wednesday that his focus is on getting a win in Week 2, not his job security or the potential fan reception awaiting him in the team's home opener in Week 3.

stories.title: Alonso hits 300th HR at Citi Field; ensuing curtain call 'crazy to me,' says Manaea
stories.summary: Pete Alonso launched his 300th career home run, a tying shot in the ninth inning against his former team that earned a curtain call, and Coby Mayo's inside-the-park homer in the 11th sent the Orioles to a 7-5 victory over the Mets.
